events.name: Bash
events.head: Search funnel numbers in source and whiteboard reference, check git state
events.input: $ git grep -n -E '11\.4K|\b368\b|3\.2%|\b179\b|342K|6\.89%|8\.6K|\b825\b|9\.6%|48\.6%' -- app/src | grep -v -E '\.svg|d="' | cut -c1-230 | head -60; echo ---; grep -n -E '342K|8\.6K|825|9\.6|48\.6|11\.4K|368|179' reference/whiteboard-v12-text.txt | head -20; echo ---; git log --oneline -5 origin/main; git status -sb | head -3; grep -n -i 'publish held' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read whiteboard KPI block and the day-art and visuals code

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fix indent, check publish hold, find publish procedure and launch config
events.input: $ sed -i '' "s|^      // inV/outV only set the ribbon's taper|    // inV/outV only set the ribbon's taper|" app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/system.tsx && grep -n -i -E 'held|hold' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -4 | cut -c1-260; echo ---; grep -n -E 'PUBLISHED' workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -2 | cut -c1-500; echo ---; ls scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'publish|mirror|export' ; grep -n -E '"(dev|build|start|export)[^"]*"' app/package.json; cat .claude/launch.json | head -40; git -C . diff --stat -- .claude

events.text: Funnel numbers are aligned in the three files (old 11.4K / 368 / 3.2% / 179 chain gone). Now running typecheck and the probes locally to chase the two probe failures, then push and publish.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Typecheck and locate the mirror export script and publish notes
events.input: $ (cd app && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "tsc exit $?") ; find . -name 'export-static.sh' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -3; grep -l -i -E 'mirror|publish' /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/*.md | head -8; grep -n -i -E 'publish|mirror' /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/MEMORY.md | cut -c1-220 | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start the local dev server on 4322 and wait until it serves /masterclass
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && (PORT=4322 nohup npx next dev -p 4322 > /tmp/t001-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4322/masterclass 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 3; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:4322/masterclass; tail -3 /tmp/t001-dev.log

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && cat /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/mirror-export-clean-worktree.md | cut -c1-1500; echo ----; cat /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/mirror-publish-holds.md | cut -c1-700; echo ----; cd app && (BASE=http://localhost:4322 node scripts/probe-funnels.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v -i -E '^\s*(ok|pass|✓)' | tail -25)

events.input: $ grep -rn -E 'api/me\b' src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | cut -c1-220 | head -12; ls src/app/api 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; (BASE=http://localhost:4322 node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs > /tmp/t001-pw.log 2>&1; echo exit $?); wc -l /tmp/t001-pw.log; grep -n -v -E '^\s*(ok|PASS|✓)' /tmp/t001-pw.log | cut -c1-300 | tail -25

events.input: $ sed -n 42,56p src/app/onboarding/old-plan.tsx; echo ---; sed -n 1,75p src/app/onboarding/centre/api.ts; echo ---; grep -rn -E 'getMe\(' src | cut -c1-200; git status --short src/app/onboarding | head; git diff --stat -- src/app/onboarding/onboarding-client.tsx | tail -1

events.head: Inspect the other lane's onboarding diff, centre load path and static export flags
events.input: $ git diff -- src/app/onboarding/onboarding-client.tsx | grep '^[+-]' | cut -c1-300; echo ---; sed -n 100,135p src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx | cut -c1-220; echo ---; grep -n -E 'NEXT_PUBLIC|BASE_PATH|STATIC|export ' scripts/export-static.sh | head -20; grep -rn -E 'NEXT_PUBLIC_(STATIC|MIRROR|EXPORT)[A-Z_]*' src next.config.* | cut -c1-170 | head -8
